content: Connection analyzer for ExpressRoute Circuit introduces a faster, evidence-based way to find where packet loss occurs on an ExpressRoute circuit. When customers see packet loss between Azure and on-premises today, it is often hard to tell whether the problem lies with the Microsoft Enterprise Edge (MSEE), the connectivity provider, or the customer's own network. That leads to guesswork and long back-and-forth investigations. With this release, customers can pinpoint whether the loss originates at the MSEE. Connection analyzer runs on-demand iPerf test traffic from an Azure virtual machine to an on-premises destination over the ExpressRoute circuit, and captures packets at the MSEE. It then reports whether packet loss is occurring at the MSEE and flags out-of-order packet delivery. The full packet capture (pcap) is available to download for deeper analysis. This enhancement replaces guesswork with proof. If the loss is at the MSEE, customers have clear evidence to act on. If it isn't, they can quickly focus their investigation on the provider or customer side of the circuit. Built specifically for Azure-to-on-premises traffic, it helps teams narrow down the source of connectivity issues without lengthy manual analysis. By bringing packet-level visibility to the Microsoft edge, Azure helps customers isolate ExpressRoute issues faster, shorten time to resolution, and keep their hybrid workloads running reliably. Learn more.
